entry.title: New PDF tools
entry.content:
• New tool: New tool: split the double pages of a PDF into two single pages, with an adjustable cut line, right-to-left order and pages to exclude.
  • New tool: New tool: merge separately scanned fronts and backs PDFs into one PDF with alternating pages, with a preview of the order.

entry.title: XML tools, Ctrl+K search, chains and settings
entry.content:
• New tool: New tool "YAML and TOML viewer and editor": the file as a tree with search, the path of each node, editing of keys, values and types, undo and redo, and conversion between YAML and TOML.
  • New tool: New tool "YAML and CSV compare": the differences between two YAML files (with path, lists matched by key) or two CSV files, with rows matched by the key columns you choose.
  • New tool: New tool "JSON Schema ↔ XSD converter": converts elements, attributes, types, restrictions and occurrences both ways; anything with no equivalent is listed in the warnings with its location.
  • New tool: New tool "Test data generator from a schema": from a JSON Schema or an XSD it generates records that conform to it, with a repeatable seed, any number of records and export as JSON, XML or CSV.
  • New tool: New tool "PDF metadata": view and edit a PDF's title, author and dates, or remove all metadata (XMP and custom keys too) before sharing it.
  • New tool: New tool "PDF page numbers, headers and footers": write the number, total, date or text at the top and bottom of every page, with preview, page selection, a skipped cover and rotated pages.
  • New tool: New tool "Compress PDF": recompresses the PDF's images (quality and size of your choice), optimises the file or turns pages into images, and shows the saving before the download.
  • New tool: New tool "Crop and resize PDF": remove margins in millimetres with a preview, change the page scale or fit pages to A4, A5, A3, Letter and Legal.
  • New tool: New tool "Extract images from PDF": the embedded images at original quality (identical JPEGs, the others as PNG with transparency too), with preview, selection and ZIP download.
  • New tool: New tool "Fill in and flatten PDF forms": fill in a form's text, checkboxes, choices and menus and download the filled or flattened PDF, with the values fixed on the page.
  • New tool: New tool "Black out parts of a PDF": black rectangles drawn on the pages or a text search to cover everywhere; redacted pages become images, so the text underneath no longer exists in the file.
  • New tool: New tool "Protect a PDF with a password": a password to open the file with 256-bit AES encryption and optional print, copy and edit restrictions, all in your browser.
  • New tool: New tool: tree-based XML editor and viewer, with search across tags, attributes and text, XPath queries, namespaces, editing of tags, attributes and content, adding, moving and deleting nodes, undo and redo.
  • New tool: New tool "XML compare": the structural differences between two documents (added and removed elements, changed attributes and text) with the XPath, without the noise of indentation and attribute order.
  • New tool: New tool "XML to table and CSV": pick the repeating element, flatten attributes and children into columns, preview it and download the CSV or send it to the other tools.
  • New tool: New tool "XSD validator": check an XML against an XSD schema (types, facets, element order and count, required attributes, IDs) and see each problem with its XPath.
  • New tool: New tool "XML ↔ JSON": converts XML to JSON and JSON to XML both ways, with attributes, text and repeated elements; prefix, arrays and types (numbers and booleans) of your choice, errors with line and column.
  • New tool: New tool "HTML and DOM viewer": the page as a DOM tree, queries with CSS selectors and XPath, XPath and CSS path of each node; no script is run.
  • Improvement: The "Send to…" menu has a field to filter tools when the list is long: type part of the name and press Enter to send to the first result.
  • Improvement: Quick search with Ctrl+K (⌘+K on Mac) from any page: type a tool name, pick with the arrow keys and press Enter. There is also a magnifier button in the header.
  • Improvement: Tool chains: link several tools in a path (for example JSON Formatter → JSON Viewer), save it and, after each step, "Send to…" offers the next one first. Saved chains keep only a name and the tools, never your data.
  • Improvement: Export and import all your settings (theme, favorites and menus, chains) in a single JSON file from the Privacy page, to move them to another device.

entry.title: Tax code, text comparison and printing
entry.content:
• New tool: New tool: UTM link builder for campaigns, with channel presets, warnings about case and spaces, several sources at once and .csv download.
  • New tool: New tool: trip cost and fuel consumption, with conversion between l/100 km, km/l and mpg, a CO2 estimate and a range calculation for a budget.
  • New tool: New tool "List ↔ line": turn a list into a single line with separators and quotes (presets for SQL, JSON, JavaScript, CSV, URL and command line, with the right escaping) and a line back into a list, respecting quoted items.
  • New tool: New tool "Text extractor": paste a text and get the list of emails, links, IPs, dates, phone numbers, IBANs, hashtags and more, with a count per kind, duplicates removed, your choice of order, copy and download as .txt or .csv.
  • New tool: New tool: converts text to bytes (hex, binary, decimal, octal, Base64) and back, with several encodings, a character table and a hex dump preview of a file.
  • New tool: New tool: string escape and unescape for JSON, JavaScript, Python, regex, shell, SQL, CSV, Java and PHP, with precise errors and emoji support.
  • New tool: New tool: create ZIP archives from files and folders, or open a ZIP, search the list and download only what you need, with checks against dangerous archives.
  • New tool: New tool: redact parts of an image with a solid box, pixelation or blur, with undo and redo and no metadata in the output file.
  • New tool: New tool: split the bill equally or by consumption, with tip, shared costs and share rounding.
  • New tool: New tool: countdown to a date, with working days, time zones, holidays and an .ics calendar file.
  • New tool: New tool "List compare": paste two lists and see the union, items in common, only in A, only in B and duplicates, with counts, copy and download for each tab.
  • New tool: New tool "Text cleaner": paste text from a PDF, email or Word and get a clean version, with lines joined, double spaces removed, straight quotes, and invisible characters and HTML tags stripped.
  • Improvement: At the bottom of every tool you now find links to related tools, to move from one to another without going back to the home page.
  • New tool: Timer with countdown, stopwatch with laps and Pomodoro; scientific calculator with history; generator of random numbers, dice, draws from a list and teams.
  • New tool: Text extraction from PDFs, password-protected ones too: lines, paragraphs and columns rebuilt, download as TXT or Markdown.
  • New tool: Generator of Italian tax codes and VAT numbers with test data, handy for testing forms and software.
  • New tool: IP subnet calculator, docker run to Docker Compose converter, CSS clamp() generator, time calculator and invoice due dates.
  • New tool: Structural JSON diff: differences by path with old and new value, arrays by index, as sets or by key, merged tree view and JSON Patch export.
  • Feature: Keyboard shortcuts in every tool: press ? to see the list.
  • Feature: On the home page you can paste some text or drop a file, and the site suggests the right tools.
  • Feature: With the installed app you can share text and files to rrstudio tools and open them with the right tools.
  • Feature: Print the results of the calculation tools, with a clean layout.
  • Feature: From every tool you can report a problem or suggest an improvement: a pre-filled GitHub form opens.
  • Feature: This What's new page, with a feed to follow updates, and a "New" badge on newly added tools.
  • Improvement: Easier text comparison: results scroll in their own area, the toolbar stays in view, you can hide the texts, wrap lines and jump to a line, and move between differences with F7.

entry.title: Installable app, favorites and many new tools
entry.content:
• New tool: Watermark for images and PDFs, color picker and palette from an image, SVG to PNG, image format converter.
  • New tool: HMAC, SSH key and CSR generators, secret sharing with Shamir.
  • New tool: Color and cURL converters, URL parser, compound interest.
  • New tool: Statistics, aspect ratio, Unicode inspector, Roman numerals, Morse code, classic ciphers, lire to euro.
  • New tool: Fake data, JSONPath queries, PDF signing, image crop and rotate, meta tag preview.
  • New tool: Thirty-one tools at once: Italian withholding tax, mortgage payments, numbers in words, YAML, XML and SQL formatters, TOTP, file encryption, QR code reader and many more.
  • Feature: The site can be installed as an app and also works offline.
  • Feature: Favorites and custom menus, with export and import to a file and a link to move them to another device. They stay in your browser.
  • Feature: Shareable links in 36 tools: the settings you chose are restored for whoever opens the link. Your files never end up in the link.
  • Feature: "Send to…": pass the result of one tool to another without copy and paste.
  • Improvement: "How to" guides and FAQs in the tools, a home page with 8 categories, a Favorites filter and more compact cards on phones.
  • Improvement: Pages appear faster and respond more quickly.

entry.title: English version and new tools
entry.content:
• New tool: QR code, VAT calculator, text diff, CSV/JSON/Excel converter, JWT, UUID, timestamp, color contrast, Markdown editor, word counter, regex tester, working days.
  • New tool: E-invoice viewer, images to PDF and PDF to images, EXIF viewer.
  • New tool: JSON viewer and editor.
  • Improvement: The tax code tool now also handles suppressed municipalities and foreign states.
  • New tool: Validation of Italian tax codes, IBANs and VAT numbers.
  • Feature: The site is available in English: add /en/ to the address or use the language switch.
  • Feature: Tools grouped by category on the home page, and a privacy notice.
  • Improvement: Better accessibility and nicer previews when a page of the site is shared.

entry.title: First release
entry.content:
• New tool: From day one: CSV to dashboard, password generator, hash calculator, PDF tools (merge, split, rotate, reorder), image compressor, Base64, URL encoding and JSON formatter.
  • Fix: PNG and PDF export: correct margins and much smaller PDF files.
